title: WHIL Wednesday – Picture of the Week
content:
4th March 2015

Being a bit of a beard enthusiast, I’m a little in awe of this fine beard which belongs to Jack Bessant of Reef. Jack will be performing with Reef this Friday (6th March) at the O2 Academy in Bristol and this photo was taken last year during their headline tour – lets hope his beard has made it through the winter. 

Reef now line up with Jesse Wood (Son of Ronnie Wood & married to Fearne Cotton) playing guitar and  I’ll be there shooting for The Fix to see their progress. 

As always, we’re interested in getting our reader photos as Photo of the Week. If you have any images you’d like to share with the world (well, mainly Bristol) please send them to contact@thefixmagazine.com with the subject ‘Photo of the week’.
 
Will Fahy
